summary: Flutter now captures a bounded local JPEG from a subscribed remote screen-video track after decoded frames are available, instead of sending/receiving thumbnail DataPackets. Queueing prevents concurrent calls into the plugin's shared frame file. Unit coverage, the 320-test full suite, analyzer, Android ABI-split release build, update install and app launch pass. No screen share or voice-room connection was started during this smoke test, so receiver thumbnail runtime behavior remains unverified.

checks.name: Thumbnail capture and cancellation tests
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_thumbnail_pipeline_test.dart test/screen_thumbnail_test.dart test/voice_participant_thumbnail_test.dart
checks.observation: Focused tests cover waiting for decoded frames, inactive-track cancellation, bounded no-frame attempts, serialized native frame capture, JPEG validation and participant thumbnail rendering.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite
checks.observation: All 320 Flutter tests pass after rebasing onto the incoming GitHub CI/test commits.

checks.name: Android release build
checks.observation: Signed ABI-split APKs built for armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a and x86_64. The arm64 APK is 39.5 MB. A universal APK was not used because its versionCode 21 is below the installed CI split APK code.

checks.name: Install over existing Pixel 7 app
checks.observation: The arm64 release APK installed without uninstalling or clearing app data. The device now reports versionName 1.0.16 and versionCode 2021.

checks.name: Pixel app launch smoke check
checks.command: adb shell monkey -p ru.boohtacord.app 1; inspect recent logcat for fatal exceptions
checks.observation: BOOHTACORD process launched on Pixel 7. Recent logcat contained no FATAL EXCEPTION or Flutter PlatformException. No account action, voice join, microphone activation or screen projection was performed.

checks.name: Remote thumbnail runtime preview
checks.observation: The Pixel was left with the app open. A room join and new Android screen projection were not started; a separate short paired preview test requires explicit live confirmation.

checks.name: Web receiver thumbnail migration
checks.observation: Web still uses the ineffective DataPacket thumbnail path. This implementation stage changes Flutter only.

remaining: Run a paired Pixel-to-Mac and Pixel-to-web preview test with an explicit short-lived screen-share authorization; confirm the thumbnail appears and clears on stop/unsubscribe, confirm bandwidth/subscription policy under ADR-013, implement the web receiver capture path, and validate Windows runtime behavior.
